source: The 31 Bash commands issued by run B1 of campaign pilot-aioquic-w02-11-20260828, the run the guard defect aborted. Captured here so the corpus outlives the campaign directory.
expected_from: Each verdict is derived by reading the command against the family list: every command group must begin with an in-family command, and any later pipe stage must be a pager. The verdicts are not a recording of what the implementation returns.

cases.command: echo "PANTHER_REPO=$PANTHER_REPO"; echo "AI_RFC_WORKSPACE=$AI_RFC_WORKSPACE"; which arfc; ls -la "$AI_RFC_WORKSPACE" 2>/dev/null || ls -la .
cases.why: first group runs echo; the groups after it run which, then ls
runs ls, which is not an arfc command

cases.command: arfc claim-upsert --help; arfc revision-record --help; arfc checkpoint --help; arfc gate --help; arfc citation-gate --help; arfc revision-tag --help; arfc draft-commit --help; arfc cluster-get --help
cases.why: eight ;-separated groups, every one an arfc command

cases.command:
arfc claim-upsert pkg.1 \
  --text "A conforming aioquic distribution MUST ship the PEP 561 marker file aioquic/py.typed inside the installed package so that type checkers consume the package's inline type information." \
  --section "Packaging and Distribution" \
  --level MUST \
  --layer packaging \
  --field intent=deliberate \
  --field testable=true \
  --anchor '{"evidence_class": "code", "locator": "aioquic/py.typed", "commit": "60258445de4728a971e4124be18997fa61ee87a2", "line": 1}' \
  --anchor '{"evidence_class": "adr", "locator": "60258445de4728a971e4124be18997fa61ee87a2"}'
cases.why: backslash continuations join one arfc command; the apostrophe in "package's" sits inside a double-quoted value and opens nothing

cases.command: arfc corpus-query "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'"
cases.why: SQL single quotes inside the double-quoted argument separate nothing

cases.command: arfc corpus-query "SELECT sha, authored_at, subject FROM commits WHERE authored_at > (SELECT authored_at FROM commits WHERE sha='60258445de4728a971e4124be18997fa61ee87a2') AND authored_at <= (SELECT authored_at FROM commits WHERE sha='f731035b44b5f0e24c3d47707d158558f5802822') ORDER BY authored_at"
cases.why: SQL comparisons and parenthesised subqueries stay inside the quoted argument; '> (' never forms the >( substitution token

cases.command: arfc corpus-query "SELECT c.sha, c.authored_at, c.subject FROM commits c JOIN file_changes f ON f.sha=c.sha WHERE f.path IN ('aioquic/quic/recovery.py','aioquic/quic/connection.py','aioquic/asyncio/protocol.py','aioquic/quic/logger.py') AND c.authored_at >= '2019-08-15' AND c.authored_at <= '2019-08-17' GROUP BY c.sha ORDER BY c.authored_at"
cases.why: a quoted SQL IN-list of single-quoted paths stays one argument
